name: Empowered Admixture
body:
Prerequisite(s): Negative admixture or positive admixture composite blast.

Benefit(s): Negative admixture and complex negative admixture can be used with infusions associated with negative blast and whichever kinetic blast they are augmenting. Positive admixture and complex positive admixture can be used with infusions associated with positive blast and whatever kinetic blast they are augmenting. For example, a negative admixture fire blast can be used with infusions associated with fire blast and negative blast.

Normal: A negative admixture, complex negative admixture, positive admixture, or complex positive admixture can only be used with universal infusions.
